title: [E16-05] Authenticated Web and NestJS API Boundaries
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-05 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to implement authenticated Next.js API boundaries, so I can support production pilot.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E01-10](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/38), [E01-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/39)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E01-10, E01-11.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Zod validation, rate limits, resource-level RBAC and error contracts.
- [ ] Validate payload/query schemas and return consistent safe errors.
- [ ] Enforce session, resource authorization and rate limits on authoritative NestJS endpoints.
- [ ] Secure any Next.js proxy/server boundary against unauthorized forwarding and CSRF where applicable.
- [ ] Reject unknown monitoring fields, invalid IDs and unbounded list/upload requests.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Clarify the source's Next.js API wording: NestJS remains the business API; use Zod/DTO-equivalent validation consistently rather than two competing rule sets.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Send malformed, unauthorized, oversized and rate-limited requests through both web and direct API paths; verify no bypass.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
